# Inference Kit

*Local-first inference orchestration for Hearth households.*

* **Status:** alpha ([what this means](status-vocabulary.md#alpha))
* **Language:** Rust
* **Kind:** hybrid
* **Has real code today:** Yes
* **Source:** [slash-builder/inference-kit](https://github.com/slash-builder/inference-kit)

## What it owns

Inference Kit is a cross-platform inference service for Hearth household clusters. Apps declare model dependencies (semantic versions); Inference Kit resolves, loads, and caches model weights via Storage Kit (shared across apps, mmap'd RO). Models are OS-shipped, signed at build time, and verified immutably at boot. Capability gating via Score Kit.

## What it will not do

* Training or fine-tuning (inference-only; no backprop, no graph construction)
* Model serving infrastructure (multi-model load balancing, LLM-specific optimizations like LoRA/flash-attention deferred to app logic)
* Runtime model distribution (models ship with OS; no OTA, no remote fetch)
* Prompt filtering or jailbreak detection (application-layer concern)
* Output safety gates (application-layer concern)
* Model-specific tuning (quantization strategy is app config, not Inference Kit)
* Cloud hub relay in MVP (future feature gate; local-only MVP)
* TPM attestation (optional future enhancement; not MVP)
